notes:
The heading reads Courbes exceptionnelles de type (1,1) (sur C), followed by the square-type subsection. The source writes the displayed Z/4Z, mu_4(C), unit-group comparison and its unmatched marginal parenthesis; these are transcribed as written claims. It then writes the definition and twisting expressions for E ell_0, followed by the geometric paragraph beginning Si le carré, the lattice wording and the enclosed expression. No mathematical result is supplied to complete or repair those assertions. The order-2 paragraph and the final NB phrase are transcribed, with no continuation invented after défini. No proof checking, external research or OCR was performed.

Page-specific legibility: the headings and ordinary prose are mostly clear. The capital in the enclosed expression is heavily retraced, its argument/relation are crowded, and the last Gamma index is a small exposed hook. Those features retain explicit doubts. The cancellation through lattice leaves several bodies hidden. The thin outer sketch strokes and detached marks require their own crops; the source figures have been reconstructed with the visible breaks, points and extra strokes. The completion crop for eta supplied the previously clipped top of that still-unresolved addition.

Witness comparison: C and H were compared against every baseline, mathematical neighbor, insertion, cancellation and drawing. C preserves the lower word stable and most of the final sentence that H leaves unread; H supplies the supported inserted reading euclidien and omits C’s unsupported separate un. H places the wedge index above, while the source places it below. C and H both give a closed box and a final Gamma_S, whereas the source has an open-bottom contour and a hook-shaped lower index that remains doubtful. Both origin-label readings remain available, since context does not uniquely decide 0/o. The complete canceled sketch is represented by its drawn cancellation sweeps; a second editorial strike is not superimposed on that graphic. Blind audit prefers dans at the two unit-group prepositions, with de retained as an alternative. It withdraws certainty in the overwritten starts of combinatoires and anneau, and retains lattice/entier beneath the cancellation. The drawing audit adds exposed endpoint returns, gaps in the canceled frame and the two dark patches on the central horizontal of the lower drawing. Insertion leaders remain encoded by the insertion macros and their documented attachment. The prose beside the inline drawings, outside the neutral boxes, contains no required second-reading target: its unchanged wording was checked in the complete first reading. No mathematical claim was checked in this audit.

deletion_insertion_check: All eight raised insertions were inspected: exceptionnelles attaches between Courbes/de type; ell. after Courbe; (S) after torseur; euclidien after carré; V_S between euclidien and canoniquement; mod. signes, after coordonnées; réseau replaces the struck lattice candidate; eta_S attaches after canonique by the complete curved contour. The canceled left inline sketch is drawn with its actual sweeps, including the surviving outline. The horizontal strike through axes de covers those two words; the neighboring deux remains live. The canceled lattice candidate remains doubtful because its bodies are hidden; réseau is live above it. Dark retracing in combinatoires and the enclosed left label is not converted into an invented earlier word or formal cancellation. The whole source and prepared halves were each viewed once. Nineteen first-reader crops were inspected: eighteen initial localized loci, plus the necessary eta completion before that locus was decided. No decided locus was newly cropped. No second-reading crops and no TeX compilation were performed.
legibility: The headings and ordinary prose are mostly clear. The enclosed expression has a heavily retraced argument, a crowded relation and a small hook-shaped Gamma index; these retain local doubts. The cancelled lattice candidate has hidden letter bodies. The three round origin labels retain 0/o alternatives. The fine drawing strokes, detached marks and completed eta insertion were inspected on the saved crops. C preserves stable and most of the final sentence; H supports the inserted euclidien. Both witnesses need corrections to the enclosure and graphical details.
root_adjudication: Root personally viewed the whole page and every one of the nineteen saved first-reading crops. The raised euclidien, absent separate un, lower wedge index, open-bottom enclosure, added drawing points and strokes, stable wording and eta additions follow the exposed ink. The three round origin labels retain 0/o; no mathematical identification is used to choose their glyphs. The argument, relation, final Gamma index and cancelled lattice remain doubtful. The final TeX, report, complete difference coverage and twenty-five neutral second boxes were reviewed.
